task_completion.description: At least two interior partition walls are added to separate the public area from the back office.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for new wall segments in the 2D plan or 3D view that divide the open shell into distinct sections.

task_completion.description: At least three defined rooms or zones (Waiting Area, Service Counters, Back Office) are created and named/color-coded.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Check for room labels (text) or distinct floor coloring in the 2D plan view identifying the three required zones.

task_completion.description: At least two doors are placed for secure access between zones.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least two door icons in the 2D plan or door models in the 3D view, typically placed on the partition walls.

task_completion.description: The Waiting Area contains at least 30 chairs or benches.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Count the seating units in the designated Waiting Area; there should be a high density of chairs/benches visible in the 3D view or 2D plan.

task_completion.description: The Service Counters zone features at least eight desks and eight office chairs.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Look for a row or cluster of at least 8 desk units, each paired with an office chair, forming the customer service line.

task_completion.description: The Back Office is equipped with at least four administrative storage units (shelving/filing cabinets).
task_completion.visual_evidence: Identify at least 4 storage-type furniture items (tall cabinets, filing drawers, or shelves) within the Back Office zone.
Look for the agent clicking the 'Save' icon, selecting 'File > Save', or a 'Save' dialog box appearing at the end of the trajectory.

integrity.description: The agent used the Sweet Home 3D GUI to place and arrange items.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots should show the mouse cursor interacting with the furniture catalog, 2D plan, and 3D view, rather than just terminal commands.

integrity.description: The layout was built incrementally rather than appearing instantly.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots should show the gradual addition of walls, then rooms, then furniture items over time.

integrity.description: The agent worked within the 'dmv_starter.sh3d' file.
integrity.visual_evidence: The window title bar of Sweet Home 3D should ideally show 'dmv_starter.sh3d' or the agent is seen opening this specific file.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The task starts with an empty shell from 'dmv_starter.sh3d'. To pass (score >= 70), the agent must create three zones: 'Waiting Area' (30+ seats), 'Service Counters' (8+ desks and 8+ chairs), and 'Back Office' (4+ storage units). The layout requires at least 2 interior walls and 2 doors. The agent must act as a Facility Planner.
